expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: the 2025 email trial left reminders unopened and doubled
missed pickups, which is why reminders go by SMS.
expectations.evidence: The agent states that email was tried April–June 2025, “34% of reminders went unopened, missed pickups rose from 6% to 13%, and fresh food got thrown out. SMS was reinstated in July 2025 for that reason,” and warns that switching to email “would reintroduce a failure the pantry already measured and reverted.”

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/reminders.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/reminders.md at step 5; first edit at step None

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back the missed pickups and thrown-away food of the 2025 email trial.
expectations.evidence: The agent left the change out and explained the prior harm: “missed pickups rose from 6% to 13%, and fresh food got thrown out” and “I'm not making that change.”
